```{python}
#| label: setup
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from matplotlib_venn import venn2, venn3
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

from _lib import (
    DATA_DIR,
    load_identifiers,
    load_additional_excluded_pscids,
)


# ── helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def rc_to_iids(rc_set):
    return {f"{int(rc)}C" for rc in rc_set} | {f"{int(rc)}M" for rc in rc_set}


# ── Load identifiers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

identifiers = load_identifiers()


# ── Remapped cohort (all IIDs before QC/control filtering) ────────────

remapped_fam = pd.read_csv(
    DATA_DIR / "HBCD_remapped.fam",
    sep=r"\s+", header=None,
    names=["FID", "IID", "PAT", "MAT", "SEX", "PHENO"],
)
remapped_ids = set(remapped_fam["IID"])

controls_file = pd.read_csv(
    DATA_DIR / "Removed_controls.txt",
    sep=r"\s+", header=None,
    names=["FID", "IID"],
)
control_ids = set(controls_file["IID"])
# xls = pd.ExcelFile("../data/HBCD_genetics_QC1_missing_race_LORIS.xlsx")
# sheets = xls.sheet_names
qc_fails = pd.read_excel(
    Path("../data/HBCD_genetics_QC1_missing_race_LORIS.xlsx"),
    sheet_name="Exclude_Summary",
)
qc_raw = qc_fails["Study_ID"].dropna().astype(str).str.strip()
qc_df = qc_raw.str.extract(r"(?P<pscid>.+)(?P<rel>[CM])$")
qc_df = qc_df.merge(
    identifiers[["pscid", "release_candid"]].drop_duplicates(subset="pscid"),
    on="pscid", how="inner",
)
qc_fail_ids = set(qc_df["release_candid"].astype(int).astype(str) + qc_df["rel"])

onlyqc_ids = remapped_ids - qc_fail_ids - control_ids


# ── Exclusion lists ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

exc_pscids_csv = load_additional_excluded_pscids()

exc_rc_csv = set(
    identifiers.loc[identifiers["pscid"].isin(exc_pscids_csv), "release_candid"]
    .dropna().astype(int).unique()
) if exc_pscids_csv else set()

excl_csv = pd.read_csv(DATA_DIR / "HBCDexclusions.csv")
excl_lists = {}
for col in excl_csv.columns:
    pscids = set(excl_csv[col].dropna().astype(str).str.strip())
    pscids = {p for p in pscids if p and p != "nan"}
    excl_lists[col] = pscids

excl_iids_lists = {}
for name, pscids in excl_lists.items():
    rc_set = set(
        identifiers.loc[identifiers["pscid"].isin(pscids), "release_candid"]
        .dropna().astype(int).unique()
    )
    excl_iids_lists[name] = rc_to_iids(rc_set)

all_exc_iids = set()
for s in excl_iids_lists.values():
    all_exc_iids |= s
```

---

## Panel A: QC Filter — Total vs onlyQc

What gets removed by genomics QC and control filtering?

```{python}
#| label: cardinality-a
n_controls = len(control_ids & remapped_ids)
n_qc = len(qc_fail_ids)
print(f"  Total (remapped)      : {len(remapped_ids):>6} IID")
print(f"  └─ Controls removed   : {n_controls:>6} IID")
print(f"  └─ QC failures removed: {n_qc:>6} IID")
print(f"  onlyQc (QC-pass)      : {len(onlyqc_ids):>6} IID")
```

```{python}
#| label: venn-qc-removal
#| fig-cap: "Total remapped cohort vs QC-passing subjects (IID level)"
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 6))
v = venn2(
    subsets=(
        len(remapped_ids - onlyqc_ids),
        len(onlyqc_ids - remapped_ids),
        len(remapped_ids & onlyqc_ids),
    ),
    set_labels=("Total (HBCD)", "onlyQc (QC-pass)"),
    set_colors=["#1f78b4", "#33a02c"],
    ax=ax,
)
ax.set_title("QC + Control Removal (IID level)", fontsize=13)
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
ax.legend(
    handles=[
        Patch(facecolor="#1f78b4", alpha=0.5, label=f"Total ({len(remapped_ids)})"),
        Patch(facecolor="#33a02c", alpha=0.5, label=f"QC-pass ({len(onlyqc_ids)})"),
    ],
    loc="lower left", fontsize=9,
)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

---

## Panel B: Exclusion Criteria Overlap

How do the individual exclusion sources overlap with each other?

```{python}
#| label: venn-exclusion-overlap
#| fig-cap: "Overlap between the three HBCDexclusions.csv columns (IID level)"
names = list(excl_iids_lists.keys())[:3]
s0 = excl_iids_lists[names[0]]
s1 = excl_iids_lists[names[1]]
s2 = excl_iids_lists[names[2]]

subsets = (
    len(s0 - s1 - s2),
    len(s1 - s0 - s2),
    len((s0 & s1) - s2),
    len(s2 - s0 - s1),
    len((s0 & s2) - s1),
    len((s1 & s2) - s0),
    len(s0 & s1 & s2),
)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 7))
v = venn3(
    subsets,
    set_labels=[n.split(":")[0] for n in names],
    set_colors=["#1f78b4", "#e31a1c", "#33a02c"],
    ax=ax,
)
ax.set_title("Exclusion source overlap (IID level)", fontsize=13)
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
handles = [
    Patch(facecolor=c, alpha=0.5, label=f"{n} ({len(excl_iids_lists[n])})")
    for n, c in zip(names, ["#1f78b4", "#e31a1c", "#33a02c"])
]
ax.legend(handles=handles, loc="lower left", fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

```{python}
#| label: exclusion-table
print(f"{'Column':<45} {'IIDs':>6}  {'Unique to this':>14}")
print("─" * 68)
for name, iid_set in sorted(excl_iids_lists.items(), key=lambda x: -len(x[1])):
    others = set()
    for n2, s2 in excl_iids_lists.items():
        if n2 != name:
            others |= s2
    unique = len(iid_set - others)
    print(f"  {name:<43} {len(iid_set):>6}  {unique:>14}")
print()
all_combined = set()
for s in excl_iids_lists.values():
    all_combined |= s
print(f"  Combined unique IID count       : {len(all_combined):>6}")
```

---

## Panel C: Exclusions vs onlyQc

How many of the QC-passing subjects end up on an exclusion list?

```{python}
#| label: cardinality-c
print(f"  onlyQc (QC-pass)          : {len(onlyqc_ids):>6} IID")
print(f"  Combined exclusion lists  : {len(all_exc_iids):>6} IID")
print(f"  onlyQc ∩ exclusions       : {len(onlyqc_ids & all_exc_iids):>6} IID")
print(f"  onlyQc ∖ exclusions       : {len(onlyqc_ids - all_exc_iids):>6} IID  ← candidates for release")
```

```{python}
#| label: venn-excl-vs-onlyqc
#| fig-cap: "Overlap between onlyQc and combined exclusion lists (IID level)"
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 6))
v = venn2(
    subsets=(
        len(onlyqc_ids - all_exc_iids),
        len(all_exc_iids - onlyqc_ids),
        len(onlyqc_ids & all_exc_iids),
    ),
    set_labels=("onlyQc (QC-pass)", "Excluded (IID)"),
    set_colors=["#33a02c", "#ff7f00"],
    ax=ax,
)
ax.set_title("Exclusions vs onlyQc (IID level)", fontsize=13)
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
ax.legend(
    handles=[
        Patch(facecolor="#33a02c", alpha=0.5, label=f"onlyQc ({len(onlyqc_ids)})"),
        Patch(facecolor="#ff7f00", alpha=0.5, label=f"Excluded ({len(all_exc_iids)})"),
    ],
    loc="lower left", fontsize=9,
)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
